history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration, in coordination with the United Nations Sustainable Development Group, take action for the development of a United Nations Sustainable Development Group platform to facilitate the fast-tracking of the implementation of the common back offices project.
history.administration_response: The platform is included in the revised efficiency road map, which was endorsed by the United Nations Sustainable Development Group principals in August 2022. The service delivery platform was implemented in Viet Nam as planned in May 2022. Therefore, the Development Coordination Office requests that the Board close this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the service delivery platform was implemented in Viet Nam as planned in May 2022, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
